intent: Externalized configuration (@ConfigurationProperties prefix pulsestream.telemetry, constructor binding) holding reorder window seconds, bus buffer capacity and per-metric Sensor Metric Bounds (nested record Bounds). Validates window>0 and capacity>0. Also provide application.yml entries (heart rate 30-240, power 0-2500, cadence 0-220, swim pace min 45, window 60, capacity) and enable binding via @ConfigurationPropertiesScan/@EnableConfigurationProperties on a config, WITHOUT adding a second @SpringBootApplication.

methods.signature: public TelemetryProperties(long reorderWindowSeconds, int busBufferCapacity, java.util.Map<String, TelemetryProperties.Bounds> metricBounds)
public record Bounds(double min, double max)
